releaseNotes: Nexus Multi-Touch & AI Engine: Full kernel alignment with low-latency touch translation, cognitive hardware tuning, and adaptive gaming pace.

Centralized VIP Cockpit Touch Listener: Touch Listener activation is centralized exclusively in the Game Nuke Home/Dashboard for VIP subscribers. Floating HUD features direct Sensi Panel and Macro Studio cards with VIP + Touch Listener lock protection.
Safe Component Master Guard: Macro Studio and Sensi Panel are safely locked in floating HUD until Touch Listener is activated from the Home cockpit by a VIP user.
100% English Global Default & Real-Time Dynamic Translation: Universal English default terminology across all components with full locale-aware translation.
Aesthetic Blurred Game Artwork: Game profiles display elegant, low-overhead GPU blurred backdrops matching each game's emblem.
Thermal & CPU Load Optimization: Throttled ADB background polling and zero-allocation Compose drawing to keep the device running cool.
Absolute Zero-Ghost Touch Protection: Hardware kernel BTN_TOUCH release detection guarantees instant pointer purge with zero phantom taps.
Ironclad Process Immunity Shield: Sentinel, Task Manager, and Autonomous AI Agent 100% protect Game Nuke, active games, and all OEM/3rd-party screen recorders.
Cross-Brand Android 11–16 Stability: Pre-flight injection capability tests ensure zero screen freeze across Samsung, Xiaomi/HyperOS, Oppo, Vivo, Asus ROG, Transsion, and Pixel.
